spec.Size: 1-1/2 in inside, 38 mm. Old end looks about 1 mm larger from wear.
spec.33 mm: 33 mm is 1.30 in. That is Gates 25253, the 1-1/4 in flex hose.
spec.Shape: 24024 is a straight stick. This run bends. Do not buy it.
spec.Buy: Vulco-Flex II, 1-1/2 in. 25474 is 12 in, 25476 is 14 in, 25478 is 17 in, 25480 is 20 in, 25482 is 22 in, 25484 is 25 in. Trim the plain cuffs.
spec.Pressure: About 30 psi on the Gates page for this diameter. GM 3.0 manual says not to pressure-test above 20 psi.

log.text: Failed attempt. Tried to build the burst run from JEGS elbows and cut 24024 legs: 555-511176 90, 555-511181 45, 555-511171 straight. Molded SKUs 22039, 22476, 05-3093, and 20121 had already missed. Too complicated. Not the hose.

spec.Build: Metal tube OD equals hose ID. Bead on each metal end. Clamp behind the bead. Two clamps per joint.
spec.Hose: Gates 24024, 1-1/2 in × 3 ft. Cut into short legs. Do not run the whole stick around the bend. O'Reilly: https://www.oreillyauto.com/detail/c/vulco/gates-vulco-coolant-hose/gatg/24024
spec.Radiator: This radiator's barb is 1-1/4 in. 1-1/2 hose needs JEGS 555-511285, the 8 in 1-1/2 to 1-1/4 reducer, on that end.
spec.Clamps: Worm size 28 on 1-1/2 hose. Gates 32028. Two per joint.
spec.Skip: Spectre 5166 is a clamp, not an elbow. Spectre intake tubing and PVC are not coolant.

log.text: Failed attempt. Listed two flex candidates at once: Green Stripe 1-3/4 even, and Vulco-Flex II 25530 1-1/2 × 1-3/4 step. The step hose is not it.
